question: Obtain the equation of the tangent to the curve $y=\sin x$ at $x=\frac{\pi}{3}$.
explanation: Point of contactAt $x=\frac{\pi}{3}$,$$y=\sin\frac{\pi}{3}=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$$Thus, the point is $\left(\frac{\pi}{3},\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)$.Slope of the tangent$$\frac{dy}{dx}=\cos x$$Therefore,$$m=\cos\frac{\pi}{3}=\frac{1}{2}$$Point-slope equation$$y-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}=\frac{1}{2}\left(x-\frac{\pi}{3}\right)$$ConclusionThe required tangent is $y-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}=\frac{1}{2}\left(x-\frac{\pi}{3}\right)$.
